description: A library for orchestrating interactions with various Large Language Models (LLMs).
releaseNotes:
Version 4.0.0:

Breaking changes:
- The provider response models (OpenAIResponse, AnthropicResponse, GeminiResponse, DeepSeekResponse, LLMStudioResponse and their types such as Choice, Message, Candidate, Content and Part) are now internal. They were implementation details of the providers; use LLMResponse (Text, Reasoning, Usage, FinishReason) instead
- maxTokens is no longer capped at 4096: the value you set is sent to the provider (4096 stays the default). Code that passed more than 4096 now gets that value instead of 4096; the provider rejects values above the model's limit
- LLMClient.LastReasoning is null after a failed call (before, it kept the previous call's value). The same applies to the new LastUsage and LastFinishReason
- No package dependencies: the System.Text.Json 9.0.3 package reference is removed and LLMKit uses the System.Text.Json built into .NET. Apps that use System.Text.Json 9 or later features and only got the package through LLMKit must reference it themselves

New:
- Token usage: LLMResponse.Usage and LLMClient.LastUsage return the input, output and reasoning tokens reported by the provider
- Finish reason: LLMResponse.FinishReason and LLMClient.LastFinishReason tell whether the answer is complete, cut off at maxTokens (or empty because the reasoning used all the tokens) or blocked by the content filter
- LLMClient.Capabilities (and ILLMProvider.GetCapabilities) to check whether the model gets the reasoning effort and the temperature, can turn reasoning off, returns reasoning text and accepts images. ILLMProvider.GetCapabilities has a default implementation, so custom providers keep compiling
- LLMClient.GetSupportedProviders() lists the names of the implemented providers
- The package includes the XML documentation (IntelliSense) and a symbol package (.snupkg) for debugging into LLMKit

Fixes and provider changes:
- OpenAI: reasoning models are detected by generation (GPT-5 and later, o-series), so newer models such as GPT-6 receive the reasoning effort instead of ignoring it
- OpenAI: None is sent as the lowest supported level on models without "none" (GPT-5.0: minimal; o-series, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol: low)
- OpenAI: new constructor overload with isReasoningModel for model names LLMKit cannot classify
- OpenAI: chat-latest no longer fails with "temperature does not support 0.3": it reasons at a fixed effort, so neither the reasoning effort nor the sampling parameters are sent
- Anthropic: adaptive thinking only for Claude 4.6 and later; Claude 3.7 to 4.5 use extended thinking (budget_tokens; Opus 4.5 keeps the effort setting); no thinking parameters for older models; temperature is no longer sent with thinking
- LLMClient no longer adds an empty answer (reasoning used all the tokens, or blocked) to the conversation; with Anthropic and Gemini the next call failed because they reject empty messages
- Gemini: no thinking_config for models without thinking (before 2.5, the 2.5 image models, the text-to-speech models, Gemma 3); None and levels are mapped to the levels each model offers (including Gemma 4 and the image models); gemini-2.5-pro None uses the minimum budget 128
- LLM Studio: the API key is now sent as the Authorization header (it was ignored before)
- OpenAI and DeepSeek: request timeout raised to 3 minutes

Version 3.2.1:
- Rebuilt package: the 3.1.0 and 3.2.0 packages on NuGet contained the 3.0.0 binary by mistake. 3.2.1 contains all the changes listed below for 3.1.0 and 3.2.0

Version 3.2.0:
- Added AnthropicProvider for Claude models (Messages API)
- Added provider-neutral ReasoningEffort (LLMRequest.WithReasoningEffort and the LLMClient reasoningEffort argument) for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek and LLM Studio
- Added LLMResponse.Reasoning and LLMClient.LastReasoning to read the reasoning returned by the provider
- OpenAI: sampling parameters (temperature, top_p, penalties) are no longer sent to GPT-5 and o-series reasoning models, which reject them
- Gemini: thought summaries are separated from the answer text
- Permanent 4xx errors are no longer retried, and the API error response is included in the exception message

Version 3.1.0:
- Added LLMStudioProvider for local LLM Studio servers (OpenAI-compatible API, optional API key)
- Fixed OpenAI request payload to use max_completion_tokens
- Improved error detail in generated text failure exceptions

Version 3.0.0:
- Added multimodal support for text and images
- Enhanced conversation management with improved message history
- Added system message configuration
- Implemented automatic retries for failed requests
- Improved thread safety and error handling
- Updated to .NET 8.0
- Added comprehensive XML documentation
- Enhanced provider implementations with better error handling
